text: {"clause_coverage":1.0,"negative_coverage":1.0,"oracle_assertiveness":1.0,"boundary_coverage":1.0,"concrete_elements":[{"value":"1209600","context":"seconds for 2 weeks","grounded":true},{"value":"1209601","context":"seconds just beyond 2 weeks","grounded":true},{"value":"1209599","context":"seconds just below 2 weeks","grounded":true},{"value":"3600","context":"seconds for 1 hour","grounded":true},{"value":"0.99","context":"stability threshold","grounded":false},{"value":"0.98","context":"stability threshold","grounded":false},{"value":"real_time","context":"runtime reference","grounded":false},{"value":"max_power","context":"maximum power budget","grounded":false},{"value":"true","context":"inspiration detection flag","grounded":true},{"value":"false","context":"inspiration detection flag","grounded":false},{"value":"stress","context":"system mode","grounded":false},{"value":"normal","context":"breathing pattern","grounded":false},{"value":"variable","context":"breathing pattern","grounded":false},{"value":"none","context":"breathing pattern","grounded":false},{"value":"1","context":"time or power offset","grounded":false}],"uncovered_clauses":[],"weaknesses":["Negative test TC-008 incorrectly asserts the same condition as the positive test; should assert failure.","Assertions use abstract variables (real_time, max_power) without concrete values, reducing test determinism.","Boundary tests rely on unspecified offsets (e.g., \"- 1\") without defining the unit or value.","The suite lacks tests for error handling when clock overflows or power budget is exceeded.","No tests cover interactions between multiple requirements (e.g., power consumption during stress test)."]}
